elements.label: Figure 1.1
elements.title: It took more than a century for the metric system to spread around the world
elements.content:
Line chart showing the cumulative number of countries adopting the metric system from 1795 to 2015.
Y-axis: Cumulative number of countries adopting metric system, ranging from 0 to 200 in increments of 20.
X-axis: Years from 1795 to 2015 (1795, 1805, 1815, 1825, 1835, 1845, 1855, 1865, 1875, 1885, 1895, 1905, 1915, 1925, 1935, 1945, 1955, 1965, 1975, 1985, 1995, 2005, 2015).
Trend: The curve starts near 0 in 1795, remains very low until the mid-19th century, then steadily increases through the late 19th and early 20th centuries, experiences a sharp jump around 1960 (reaching approximately 110-120), and flattens out near 180 countries by 2015.
Source: Vera 2011, 494–97.
Note: The most recent adopter of the metric system, Samoa, joined in 2015.
